skill.name: Vector Space Document Representation
skill.description: Conceptual framework for representing documents as vectors of term weights and computing similarity scores using cosine distance. Covers the document-as-vector model, query vectorization, and dot-product scoring methodology.
skill.skill_body:
Explain how documents are represented as vectors of term weights in the vector space model. Describe the process of vectorizing both documents and queries, and how cosine similarity is computed between them. Reference the SMART system (Salton 1971) as a foundational implementation and Zobel & Moffat (2006) for cosine score computation details.

## Objective

vector_space_scoring_model
## Applicable Signals

- Designing or explaining document ranking systems
- Implementing cosine similarity scoring
- Training teams on vector space model foundations
- Establishing baseline scoring methodology before advanced techniques

## Contraindications

- Probabilistic language models are the primary scoring approach
- Neural embedding methods are being used instead of classical vector space
- Context requires modern deep learning-based retrieval systems

## Constraints

- This is a reference-level knowledge asset; it provides conceptual understanding, not operational code or parameter tuning
- Assumes familiarity with basic linear algebra and document indexing concepts

## Output Contract

- Practitioner understands document vectorization, query vectorization, and cosine score computation
- Practitioner can cite SMART system (Salton 1971) and Zobel & Moffat (2006)
- Practitioner can explain why medium-frequency terms are important and how term weighting relates to tf-idf
